content: Hi, I’m Warren, new here. Just opened PR #42465 adding five Euclid Book I constructions (I.1, I.2, I.3, I.7, I.9) that weren’t in mathlib yet. All zero-sorry, CI should be green shortly. Happy to take any feedback!

Hi Warren, welcome to the community.

I have not taken an in depth look at your PR but here are some early remarks:

  • Your PR doesn't adhere to the Mathlib structure. It should be in that format for it to get merged. Please take some time to familiarize yourself with it. Look for example at an arbitrary file, check how it is formatted and compare it to what you have made. If you run into troubles, feel free to post your questions here.
  • Your PR looks at least partially LLM generated, see Geometry/Euclid.lean. Mention this is in your PR. People are more inclined to review and to help you learn if you highlight if and how you used it.

It seems to me that the PR uses real numbers and cos/sin to do Euclid's geometry. Just a historical remark, Euclid's geometry was born around 300 BCE, while the term "real numbers" was rigorously defined much later, with a gap of more than 2000 years.

Mention this is in your PR.

Let me emphasize that disclosing LLM use is required for contributing to mathlib, per #use-of-ai (that's a link you can click on to see mathlib's full policy about AI use).
